limitations: Widget-test native render; no physical-device, live account, release or user approval claim.
Saved ownership 1/8/16 is explicit isolated Storage grandfathered test data, not a user account.
Four Today summary images are scrolled views, not initial-fold proof. Their primary CTA rectangles were measured before scrolling.
R16 stage1 contains zero meshes and deliberately paints neither layer; ownership0/1 therefore uses native empty-site copy.
All screenshots use100percent text;200percent functional and layout tests are separate.
Firebase is intentionally uninitialized; Gye is the actual unauthenticated empty membership state.
The greeting uses wall-clock time; no fixed-time shell seam was introduced.
